audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty text is right in shape (you lose early, win late) but is built on fabricated ability names and male pronouns for a female champion.
audit.why: Mel's real kit is Searing Brilliance (P), Radiant Volley (Q, 10/9/8/7/6s), Rebuttal (W, 38/35/33/29/26s), Solar Snare (E, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s), Golden Eclipse (R, 120/100/80s). The page called her W 'Shattering Bulwark', invented 'Golden Touch', and called Aurelion Sol's ult 'Voice of Light' (that is Galio's).
audit.corrected: Difficulty is driven by Solar Snare: it roots at 1000 range and cancels both Breath of Light and Astral Flight, which are the only two channels Aurelion Sol has. Early lane is Mel's; from first item the stardust curve takes over.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named the wrong abilities and gave a fabricated 'fifteen-second' cooldown for Rebuttal.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s. Golden Eclipse is 120/100/80s at 25000 range (global). Aurelion Sol's spikes are level 3 (E black hole), level 4 (W lets him channel Q while flying), level 6 (Falling Star), and Rod of Ages/Seraph's.
audit.corrected: Spikes restated with real cooldowns: Rebuttal's 38s rank-1 window is the commit invitation; Golden Eclipse is a 120s global cash-in of Overwhelm; Aurelion Sol's inflection is first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly said Rebuttal 'reflects your projectiles back' at Aurelion Sol and warned against a combo 'boomeranging into your own face'. Aurelion Sol has no projectile in his kit.
audit.why: Riot's Rebuttal text: it reflects enemy projectiles and prevents her from taking damage. Aurelion Sol's Q is a channelled beam, E is a zone, R is a ground impact — none carry the projectile flag in the kit file. So Rebuttal blanks his damage but has nothing of his to reflect.
audit.corrected: State the real decisive interaction instead: Solar Snare (E) roots and cancels Breath of Light and Astral Flight mid-channel (both are flagged interruptible), and Mel can wall off a retreat with Rebuttal's barrier while Aurelion Sol has no dash. Rebuttal is a damage blank, not a punish.
sources: champ-data/_kits/aurelionsol.json (channel flags on Q and W)

audit.why: Win rate 58.93% over 582 games matches the scaling story once the late rows are given to Aurelion Sol.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cross-layer chart disagreement: phases[4..6].side read 'Skill' while win[4..6] read 'Mel', 'Aurelion Sol', 'Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: Same row rendered two ways. Level 6 belongs to Mel (Golden Eclipse cashes Overwhelm globally against a no-escape target); first item and beyond belong to Aurelion Sol (permanent stardust, no dash on Mel to leave The Skies Descend).
audit.corrected: phases[4].side -> Mel, phases[5..6].side -> Aurelion Sol, with whys and ratings rewritten in the same proposal. win[] already held these values, so no content-layer flip was needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed — the title promises R usage and low-HP discipline, the body described a W flyby and a Q channel.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits/. report[4].t is the report mirror of breakdown.wave and had drifted out of sync on 15 matchups.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to she/her. breakdown.cooldowns given real numbers. Bled Do/Don't bodies rewritten to their own titles. Magnitude claims given the supporting number. Stale report[4].t re-synced to the rewritten breakdown.wave.

notes: Mel is female (champ-gender.js) — the inherited full-layer text used he/his/him throughout; every instance in a writable field is corrected here. Fabricated names removed: 'Shattering Bulwark' (really Rebuttal), 'Golden Touch' (not a Mel ability), 'Q Starfire' and 'Voice of Light' (Aurelion Sol's are Breath of Light and Falling Star / The Skies Descend). Rebuttal was described as reflecting Aurelion Sol's projectiles — he has none (Q is a channelled beam, E a zone, R a ground impact), so it is a damage blank, not a punish; corrected everywhere. Cross-layer chart disagreement fixed on rows 5, 6 and 7 (phases[4..6].side said 'Skill' while win[4..6] already said Mel / Aurelion Sol / Aurelion Sol). Packet defect about the chart contradicting a 58.93% win rate is resolved by giving the last two rows to Aurelion Sol, which the content layer already claimed.
